_comment: Canonical matter descriptor template (matter/<id>/matter.json). Documents every field the MatterLoop reads from the brique section, and what is opaque to the engine.

brique._comment: Required. The only section the MatterLoop reads from disk. Everything else is opaque to the engine.
brique._kind_note: Optional. The engine stamps 'matter' automatically when absent. Always 'matter' for matter descriptors.
brique._substance_mode_note: Required in practice. Accepted values: 'brique' (engine manages a local data.bin file — the only mode that supports inline or leased read/write), 'wrapper' (substance is delegated to an external wrapper — requires wrapper_name), 'ext_ref' (substance lives at an external URL or API — functional.external_retrieval.ext_ref describes how to fetch it), 'physical' (substance comes from a physical device — functional.external_retrieval.physical describes acquisition). The engine uses substance_mode to route matter.read and matter.write.
brique._wrapper_name_note: Required when substance_mode is 'wrapper'. Must match a wrapper_name declared in context.json engine_config.execution.wrappers. Empty for all other modes.
brique._revision_note: Managed by the engine when present. The engine sets it on creation and increments it (as a Unix nanosecond timestamp) on every matter.write commit — never set or modify its value manually. But do not include this key in params at all unless the architect explicitly asked for the matter to carry a tracked revision: check the matter's current descriptor first, and only pass revision-affecting params when it already has one, or when creating a new matter with revision tracking explicitly requested.
brique._substance_type_note: Optional. Tells matter.read how to serialize data.bin content. Accepted values: 'text' (content is UTF-8 text — serialized as a plain JSON string), 'binary' (content is arbitrary bytes — serialized as base64). Defaults to 'text' when absent. Declare the specific format (markdown, json, png, etc.) in functional if needed — the engine does not read it.

objective._comment: Optional but recommended. Projected by the reflexive layer for meaning queries.
objective.name: <matter_id>
objective._name_note: Conventionally matches the matter directory name.
objective.description: One sentence describing what this matter holds.

functional._comment: Completely opaque to the engine. Describe business semantics, schema refs, and retrieval config here. No field in this section is read by MatterLoop during normal operation.
functional._format_note: Optional. Describes the specific format of the substance content (e.g. 'md', 'json', 'png', 'mp4', 'csv'). Also used by the engine as the payload file extension (<matter_id>.<format>) — pair with substance_type in brique section for serialization.
functional._schema_ref_note: Optional. Absolute Brique path to the schema descriptor that constrains this matter's content. Informational only — the engine does not enforce it.

external_retrieval._comment: Describe how substance is fetched when substance_mode is 'ext_ref' or 'physical'. Opaque to the engine — consumed by wrappers or external tooling.

_subjective_note: Optional. Free-form space for subjective categorization. Add any key-value pairs meaningful to you or your team — tags, priority, notes, author opinions. The engine ignores this section entirely.
